#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

MODE="${1:---dry-run}"

if [[ "$MODE" != "--dry-run" && "$MODE" != "--apply" ]]; then
  echo "Uso: $0 [--dry-run|--apply]"
  exit 1
fi

if ! command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: Este script requiere apt-get."

fi

if [[ "$MODE" == "--apply" && "${EUID}" -ne 0 ]]; then

if [[ "$MODE" == "--apply" ]]; then
  LOG_FILE="/var/log/vulnerable-apps-remediation-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log"
  exec > >(tee -a "$LOG_FILE") 2>&1
  echo "Log: $LOG_FILE"

    printf '+'
    printf ' %q' "$@"
    printf '\n'
  else
    "$@"
  fi
}

is_installed() {

  apt-cache show "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1

  awk '!seen[$0]++'
}

  -y
  -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef
  -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold

TARGET_PACKAGES=(

  xterm
  wget
  nano
  xz-utils
  apt
  unzip
  sudo
  xserver-xorg-core
  xserver-common
)

echo "Comprobando paquetes retenidos con apt-mark hold..."
HELD_PACKAGES="$(apt-mark showhold || true)"
if [[ -n "$HELD_PACKAGES" ]]; then
  echo "AVISO: Hay paquetes retenidos. Pueden impedir la actualización:"
  echo "$HELD_PACKAGES"
  echo
fi

echo "Actualizando índices APT..."
run apt-get update

echo
echo "Detectando paquetes vulnerables instalados..."
INSTALLED_TARGETS=()

for pkg in "${TARGET_PACKAGES[@]}"; do
  if is_installed "$pkg"; then
    INSTALLED_TARGETS+=("$pkg")
  fi
done

while IFS= read -r pkg; do
  [[ -n "$pkg" ]] && INSTALLED_TARGETS+=("$pkg")
done < <(
  dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\n' 'linux-image*' 'linux-headers*' 'linux-libc-dev' 'linux-kbuild*' 2>/dev/null \
    | dedupe_packages || true
)

mapfile -t INSTALLED_TARGETS < <(printf '%s\n' "${INSTALLED_TARGETS[@]}" | dedupe_packages)

if [[ "${#INSTALLED_TARGETS[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "Paquetes instalados a actualizar:"
  printf ' - %s\n' "${INSTALLED_TARGETS[@]}"
  echo
  run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" install --only-upgrade "${INSTALLED_TARGETS[@]}"
else
  echo "No se han encontrado instalados los paquetes objetivo mediante dpkg."
fi

echo
echo "Asegurando metapaquete de kernel para recibir nuevas versiones..."
ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
KERNEL_META=""

case "$ARCH" in
  amd64)
    if uname -r | grep -q 'cloud'; then
      KERNEL_META="linux-image-cloud-amd64"
    elif uname -r | grep -q 'rt'; then
      KERNEL_META="linux-image-rt-amd64"
    else
      KERNEL_META="linux-image-amd64"
    fi
    ;;
  arm64)
    KERNEL_META="linux-image-arm64"
    ;;
esac

if [[ -n "$KERNEL_META" ]] && package_exists "$KERNEL_META"; then
  run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" install "$KERNEL_META"
else
  echo "No se ha detectado un metapaquete de kernel aplicable automáticamente para arquitectura: $ARCH"
fi

echo
echo "Remediando Sun JRE 1.5.0..."
OLD_JAVA_PACKAGES=()

while IFS= read -r pkg; do
  [[ -n "$pkg" ]] && OLD_JAVA_PACKAGES+=("$pkg")
done < <(
  dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -Ei '^(sun-java5|jre1\.5|jdk1\.5|java-1\.5)' || true
)

if [[ "${#OLD_JAVA_PACKAGES[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "Eliminando paquetes antiguos de Java:"
  printf ' - %s\n' "${OLD_JAVA_PACKAGES[@]}"
  run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" purge "${OLD_JAVA_PACKAGES[@]}"
else
  echo "No se han encontrado paquetes dpkg de Sun JRE 1.5.0."
fi

JAVA_QUARANTINE_DIR="/root/quarantine-sun-jre-1.5-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"

while IFS= read -r old_java_path; do
  [[ -z "$old_java_path" ]] && continue

  echo "Instalación antigua de Java encontrada: $old_java_path"

  if [[ "$MODE" == "--dry-run" ]]; then
    echo "+ mkdir -p $JAVA_QUARANTINE_DIR"
    echo "+ mv $old_java_path $JAVA_QUARANTINE_DIR/"
  else
    mkdir -p "$JAVA_QUARANTINE_DIR"
    mv "$old_java_path" "$JAVA_QUARANTINE_DIR/"
  fi
done < <(
  find /usr/java /usr/lib/jvm /opt \
    -maxdepth 2 \
    \( -iname 'jre1.5*' -o -iname 'jdk1.5*' -o -iname 'java-1.5*' \) \
    2>/dev/null || true
)

echo "Instalando Java soportado por la distribución..."
run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" install default-jre-headless

if command -v update-alternatives >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Reconfigurando alternativa java..."
  run update-alternatives --auto java || true
fi

echo
echo "Ejecutando full-upgrade para aplicar dependencias, kernel y parches pendientes..."
run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" full-upgrade

echo
echo "Eliminando paquetes obsoletos..."
run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" autoremove --purge

echo
echo "Limpiando caché local de paquetes..."
run apt-get clean

echo
echo "Resumen de versiones instaladas/candidatas:"
for pkg in "${TARGET_PACKAGES[@]}" "$KERNEL_META" default-jre-headless; do
  [[ -z "$pkg" ]] && continue

  if is_installed "$pkg"; then
    INSTALLED_VERSION="$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' "$pkg" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    CANDIDATE_VERSION="$(apt-cache policy "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | awk '/Candidate:/ {print $2}' || true)"
    echo " - $pkg: instalado=$INSTALLED_VERSION candidato=$CANDIDATE_VERSION"
  fi
done

echo
if [[ "$MODE" == "--apply" && -f /var/run/reboot-required ]]; then
  echo "REINICIO NECESARIO."
  cat /var/run/reboot-required.pkgs 2>/dev/null || true
elif [[ "$MODE" == "--apply" ]]; then
  echo "No se ha detectado /var/run/reboot-required."
else
  echo "Dry-run finalizado. No se han aplicado cambios."
fi

echo
echo "Finalizado."

| Root check | Requires `sudo` for `--apply` mode |
| `run()` wrapper | Dry-run mode only prints commands, never executes them |
| Logging | Writes a timestamped log to `/var/log/` in apply mode |
| Quarantine instead of delete | Old Java installations are moved, not deleted |
| `apt-mark showhold` check | Warns about held packages before upgrading |

---

### 🟡 Things to Be Aware Of

**1. `full-upgrade` is aggressive**
```bash
run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" full-upgrade
```
- This can remove packages to resolve dependency conflicts. It's more aggressive than `upgrade`. Review dry-run output carefully before applying.

**2. `--force-confold` silently keeps old config files**
```bash
-o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold
```
- New package config files will be silently ignored if old ones exist. This could leave security-relevant configs unchanged.

**3. `autoremove --purge` removes config files permanently**
```bash
run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" autoremove --purge
```
- Config files for auto-removed packages are permanently deleted. Ensure you don't need them.

**4. Java quarantine path is time-stamped per-block**
```bash

```
- If multiple old Java paths are found and seconds tick between iterations, files could land in **different quarantine directories**. Minor issue.

**5. Broad `find` scope**
```bash
find /usr/java /usr/lib/jvm /opt -maxdepth 2 ...
```
- If `/opt` contains legitimate Java 1.5-named directories (e.g., some vendor tools), they'll be moved without confirmation.

---

### 🔴 Risks if Misused

- **Only run on Debian/Ubuntu** — uses `apt-get`/`dpkg`, will fail on other distros (checked via `apt-get` guard)
- **Do not run on production without dry-run review first**
- **Kernel upgrade** may require a reboot — script detects `/var/run/reboot-required` and warns you

---

### ✅ Recommended Usage

```bash

sudo bash fix_vulnerable_apps.sh --dry-run | less

# Step 2: Review output carefully, then apply
sudo bash fix_vulnerable_apps.sh --apply

# Step 3: Reboot if prompted
```

---

### 🏁 Verdict

> Safe to run in dry-run mode immediately. Safe to apply on **non-production Debian/Ubuntu systems** after reviewing the dry-run output. Use caution on production — the `full-upgrade` step in particular deserves careful review.

MODE="${1:---dry-run}"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/vulnerable-apps-remediation-${TIMESTAMP}.log"
SUMMARY_ERRORS=()
SUMMARY_UPGRADED=()
SUMMARY_SKIPPED=()

# ─── Colors ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

if [[ -t 1 ]]; then
  C_RESET='\033[0m'
  C_BOLD='\033[1m'
  C_RED='\033[0;31m'
  C_YELLOW='\033[0;33m'
  C_GREEN='\033[0;32m'
  C_CYAN='\033[0;36m'
  C_DIM='\033[2m'
else
  C_RESET='' C_BOLD='' C_RED='' C_YELLOW='' C_GREEN='' C_CYAN='' C_DIM=''
fi

# ─── Logging ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()      { echo -e "${C_DIM}[$(date +%H:%M:%S)]${C_RESET} $*"; }
log_info() { echo -e "${C_CYAN}${C_BOLD}[INFO]${C_RESET}  $*"; }
log_ok()   { echo -e "${C_GREEN}${C_BOLD}[OK]${C_RESET}    $*"; }
log_warn() { echo -e "${C_YELLOW}${C_BOLD}[WARN]${C_RESET}  $*"; }
log_err()  { echo -e "${C_RED}${C_BOLD}[ERROR]${C_RESET} $*" >&2; }
log_dry()  { echo -e "${C_DIM}[DRY-RUN]${C_RESET} $(printf ' %q' "$@")"; }

section() {
  echo
  echo -e "${C_BOLD}${C_CYAN}══════════════════════════════════════════${C_RESET}"
  echo -e "${C_BOLD}${C_CYAN}  $*${C_RESET}"
  echo -e "${C_BOLD}${C_CYAN}══════════════════════════════════════════${C_RESET}"
}

# ─── Argument Validation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  log_err "Uso: $0 [--dry-run|--apply]"
  exit 1

  log_err "Este script requiere apt-get (Debian/Ubuntu)."
  exit 1

  exit 1
fi

# ─── Logging Setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

if [[ "$MODE" == "--apply" ]]; then
  exec > >(tee -a "$LOG_FILE") 2>&1
  log_info "Log guardado en: $LOG_FILE"
fi

# ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Execute or print depending on mode. Returns exit code of command (best-effort).
run() {
  if [[ "$MODE" == "--dry-run" ]]; then
    log_dry "$@"
    return 0
  fi

  local cmd_str
  cmd_str="$(printf '%q ' "$@")"

  if "$@"; then
    return 0
  else
    local exit_code=$?
    log_err "Comando fallido (exit $exit_code): $cmd_str"
    SUMMARY_ERRORS+=("exit=$exit_code :: $cmd_str")
    return 0  # best-effort: never abort on individual command failure
  fi
}

is_installed() {
  dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$1" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "install ok installed"
}

package_exists() {
  apt-cache show "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

dedupe_packages() {
  awk '!seen[$0]++'
}

upgrade_package() {
  local pkg="$1"
  if ! is_installed "$pkg"; then
    SUMMARY_SKIPPED+=("$pkg (no instalado)")
    return 0
  fi

  installed="$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' "$pkg" 2>/dev/null || echo 'desconocido')"

    SUMMARY_SKIPPED+=("$pkg ($installed) — ya en última versión")
    log "${C_DIM}$pkg ya está en la última versión ($installed)${C_RESET}"
    return 0
  fi

  log_info "Actualizando $pkg: $installed → $candidate"
  run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" install --only-upgrade "$pkg"
  SUMMARY_UPGRADED+=("$pkg: $installed → $candidate")
}

graceful_nginx() {
  local action="$1"  # reload | stop | start
  if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx 2>/dev/null; then

        ;;

  log_info "Kernel meta-package not applicable in this container ($ARCH) — skipped."
fi

# ─── Nginx Graceful Reload ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

section "Reloading nginx"
graceful_nginx reload

# ─── Full Upgrade ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

section "Full-upgrade (dependencies and pending patches)"
log_warn "full-upgrade may remove packages to resolve dependencies."
log_warn "Review the output carefully."
run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" full-upgrade

# ─── Autoremove ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

section "Removing obsolete packages"
run apt-get "${APT_OPTS[@]}" autoremove --purge

# ─── Clean ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

section "Cleaning APT cache"
run apt-get clean

# ─── Version Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

section "Version summary"
printf "%-40s %-30s %-30s\n" "PACKAGE" "INSTALLED" "CANDIDATE"
printf "%-40s %-30s %-30s\n" "$(printf '─%.0s' {1..40})" "$(printf '─%.0s' {1..30})" "$(printf '─%.0s' {1..30})"

for pkg in "${TARGET_PACKAGES[@]}" "$KERNEL_META" default-jre-headless; do
  [[ -z "$pkg" ]] && continue
  if is_installed "$pkg"; then
    iv="$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' "$pkg" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
    cv="$(apt-cache policy "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | awk '/Candidate:/ {print $2}' || echo '?')"
    if [[ "$iv" == "$cv" ]]; then
      printf "${C_GREEN}%-40s %-30s %-30s${C_RESET}\n" "$pkg" "$iv" "$cv"
    else
      printf "${C_YELLOW}%-40s %-30s %-30s${C_RESET}\n" "$pkg" "$iv" "→ $cv"
    fi
  fi
done

# ─── Final Report ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

section "Final report"

if [[ "${#SUMMARY_UPGRADED[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
  log_ok "Upgraded packages (${#SUMMARY_UPGRADED[@]}):"
  for item in "${SUMMARY_UPGRADED[@]}"; do
    echo -e "  ${C_GREEN}✔${C_RESET} $item"
  done
fi

if [[ "${#SUMMARY_SKIPPED[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
  log_info "Skipped packages (${#SUMMARY_SKIPPED[@]}):"
  for item in "${SUMMARY_SKIPPED[@]}"; do
    echo -e "  ${C_DIM}– $item${C_RESET}"
  done
fi

if [[ "${#SUMMARY_ERRORS[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo
  log_err "Errors encountered (${#SUMMARY_ERRORS[@]}) — review the log:"
  for item in "${SUMMARY_ERRORS[@]}"; do
    echo -e "  ${C_RED}✘${C_RESET} $item"
  done
  echo
  log_warn "The script continued in best-effort mode. Please review the errors above."
else
  echo
  log_ok "No errors detected."
fi

if [[ "$MODE" == "--apply" ]]; then
  echo
  if [[ -f /var/run/reboot-required ]]; then
    log_warn "REBOOT REQUIRED:"
    cat /var/run/reboot-required.pkgs 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    log_ok "No reboot required (expected in a Docker container)."
  fi

  log_info "Full log available at: $LOG_FILE"
else
  echo
  log_info "Dry-run complete. ${C_BOLD}No changes were applied.${C_RESET}"
  log_info "To apply changes run: ${C_BOLD}sudo $0 --apply${C_RESET}"
fi

echo
log_ok "Done."
